chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darrāj, from 'Ubayd ibn Zurārah, who said:
I said to Abī 'Abdillāh عليه السلام: Indeed, the ghurrah may be one hundred dinars, and it may be ten dinars. So he said: “Fifty.”

key_terms.بِخَمْسِينَ: at fifty, meaning fifty dinars in this context
key_terms.ٱلْغُرَّةَ: the prescribed indemnity referred to in this legal context

ai.seo_question: What is the amount of the ghurrah according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام regarding the amount of the ghurrah. When asked about differing reported amounts, the Imam عليه السلام gave the ruling as fifty dinars.
